title: What You Read Isn’t What You Hear: Linguistic Sensitivity in Deepfake Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Generating semantics-preserving transcript-level adversarial attacks (e.g., synonym substitutions) and measuring the resulting drop in detection accuracy (Accuracy Under Attack and Attack Success Rate) of audio anti-spoofing systems, as well as analyzing linguistic feature disparities like readability and perplexity between spoofed and bona-fide training data.

Comparing the vulnerability of audio anti-spoofing systems to linguistic adversarial attacks by measuring and contrasting the Attack Success Rates (ASR) and Accuracy Under Attack (AUA) across male and female synthesized voices.
